status: Supplementary sensitivity analysis specified after the original design case; not independent confirmation or external preregistration
reference: Same checksum-verified email-Eu-core projection and department roster as the original design case
reanalysis: Use all 600 archived evaluation realizations per allocation at budget 201. Compare HT totals/contrast with observed counts divided by powers of the mean vertex probability. This latter diagnostic is not a competing package or recommended estimator for unequal probabilities.
reference_oracles: Exact design covariance and exact expectation of observed counts. Report all 27 budget/plan/threshold combinations; no selection of favorable cases.
native_comparison: First evaluation seed under each allocation at budget 201; unmodified R survey 4.5 via the existing native_compare.R graph adapter. Compare totals, full covariance and all three closure contrasts. Single-run timings are provenance, not new performance benchmarks.
restrictions: No new population, independent users, confidence coverage, optimal sampling claim or new covariance-estimator Monte Carlo runs. Full reference graph is needed for the exact planning oracle. Sampled analysis uses only observed vertices, edges and known probabilities. Keep all outcomes, including unfavorable ones.
